execution.description: Validated the complete committed lesson log in canonical Linux after normalizing execution kinds.

expected: Every new execution lesson should satisfy the repository schema, including exact agreement between its filename date, lesson id and actual UTC timestamp.
observed: Validation stopped at the first overnight record whose id retained the 2026-10-04 local work-date while its actual recorded_at timestamp was on 2026-10-05 UTC. The audit found 32 such records.
keep: Keep every actual UTC timestamp unchanged.
change: Rename every mismatched lesson file and lesson_id to the actual 2026-10-05 UTC date.
